Hi all —

Thanks, Lena — confirming we can apply the earnback credit to the outstanding INV-2025-06-99. Below is the quick calculation I ran based on the amendment and seat movement date (all numbers USD):

- Core seats removed: 12 seats
- Core monthly seat rate: $90/seat
- Days unused in period (July): 24 days (change on 6th)
- Earnback (Core) = 12 * $90 * (24/30) = $8,640.00

- Flex seats added: 12 seats
- Flex monthly seat rate: $35/seat
- Charge (Flex) = 12 * $35 * (24/30) = $3,360.00

- Net credit = $8,640.00 - $3,360.00 = $5,280.00

Applying that against the outstanding INV-2025-06-99 (1,420.50) leaves a positive credit of $3,859.50 to carry forward to the next invoice. We will:
1) Apply $1,420.50 to clear INV-2025-06-99,
2) Issue an adjustment/credit memo for the remainder ($3,859.50) to be shown on your next invoice as a negative line item.

I've attached the detailed calc sheet (prorate_calc.xlsx). Marcus — please confirm VAT treatment on the adjustment for the EU entity (Lena provided EU VAT ID).

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
